root_cause.code: Host50Admission used historical BASE_TREE in active_tree gate, Capability.frozen_tree and native sourceLockTree ticket. Old production gate would always HOLD on modern approved source tree even if native owner capabilities were real.
root_cause.process: Manual and scheduled executors treated an individual reply ending after a HOLD report as a completed execution cycle; no mandatory incident ID linked code finding → owner fix → targeted verification → SHA CAS/readback → central writer CAS/readback → T09/T10 acceptance. A source-only audit entry in E06 lacked exact single error closure state in Master/Lessons/C34.
root_cause.architecture: Source owner T06 writes canonical product source; T08 only verifies proven P0/P1; T02 is sole writer of three shared Docs; T09/T10 are independent gates. This intentional split requires immutable handoffs, not magical cross-run auto-patching.
root_cause.system_limit: A synchronous chat turn cannot indefinitely run after reply. Enabled hourly automations are separate runs and must report actual execution; an automation completion != product task completion.
